title: Don't F with Pablo
overview: Narrative feature film debut of investigative journalist and documentarian Ian Halperin (His Highness Hollywood). The film is a Borat-style comedy about Pablo Escobar's illegitimate Jewish son who visits Columbia to trace his ancestral roots and start a kosher cartel.
